usedFor: responsesuite collects survey answers, and Microsoft Excel stores them as rows through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Survey Response” in responsesuite, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each response adds a row to a table, so you can sort and total the answers.

watchOut: “New Survey Response” is polling with a lookback period, so a response can arrive after a short delay.
